title: Norteam and Brickanta enter strategic partnership
summary: Read the latest articles and updates from the Brickanta team.
body_markdown:
#### Press Release


*Norteam and Brickanta have entered a partnership that combines Brickanta's AI platform for the built environment with Norteam's expertise in Microsoft Cloud and cybersecurity. The goal is to make it easier for construction and real estate companies to digitalise their work and get real value from AI across several parts of their business.*


Interest in AI is growing in construction and real estate, but for many companies adoption is still a challenge. New tools need to fit into existing IT environments and meet requirements for information security and a clear division of responsibility. The partnership between Norteam and Brickanta is designed to handle these requirements.


Brickanta's AI platform provides a solution that understands how the construction industry works, day to day. Among other things, it reads, interprets and cross-checks tender documents, contracts and technical specifications, so that work on bids, procurement, compliance and quality assurance becomes faster and more reliable.


Norteam brings deep knowledge of Microsoft Cloud, cybersecurity and modern IT environments. This ensures the AI solution works with the systems customers already use and meets their security requirements.


For companies in the built environment, the result is a shorter path from decision to value. They get started faster, run into fewer integration problems, and get a solution that can quickly grow from a first project to more parts of the business.


> *"I meet a lot of construction and real estate companies that have AI on the agenda but are stuck on where to even start. Should we look at our IT environment first, our security, or our licences? Norteam knows the Microsoft environment and security inside out, and we know construction and real estate and all its workflows. Together, we can take the customer from that first question to AI actually delivering real value."*
> **Lucas Otterling, CEO and co-founder, Brickanta**


> "I believe in partnerships that make a tangible difference for the customer. Brickanta has expertise in AI and a deep understanding of the construction industry. Combined with our expertise in Microsoft Cloud and cybersecurity, I look forward to seeing what we can create together for our customers."
> **Martin Norström, CEO and founder, Norteam**


The partnership is aimed at construction and real estate companies that want to streamline their processes and take the next step in their digital development.
